VOLTARIA ONLINE STORE — CHARGEBACK DESK, dispute forecast worksheet

Forecasting rule (desk standard FS-2): the forecast for a new dispute is the distribution of outcomes among CLOSED past disputes that are COMPARABLE to it. Comparable means all three of:
  (1) same product line as the new dispute;
  (2) same card-network reason category;
  (3) tracking status in the same group — the groups are "delivered" (delivered_signed and delivered_unsigned together), "in_transit", and "no_tracking".
Disputes with outcome OPEN are not closed and are excluded. Amount and date do not affect comparability.
